value.title: Black Eye
value.synopsis: It's been five years since that summer. Haru works as a host while saving money for his twin brothers' tuition. One day, Haru's lawyer Mikiko invites him to her office where he is reunited with Ren.

value.title: White Christmas
value.synopsis: Brothers Aki and Shima are upset by the sudden appearance of a "fourth brother" in the Kaidou family, and Haru's excessively affectionate attitude towards Ren makes Aki explode with rage. Meanwhile, Haru happens to witness a car accident in the city.

value.title: Young Grass
value.synopsis: Spring arrives, and Haru's dream of living with his brothers finally comes true. They move into a house together, and with the help of his former coworker Ikuyoshi, Haru's plans to open a cafe seem to be coming along as well.

value.title: Blue Sky
value.synopsis: Haru's cafe "WHITE FANG" begins flourishing immediately after it opens. Even Haru and Ren's recently awkward relationship is getting back to normal. However, Aki is in a terrible mood.

value.title: Rainy Season
value.synopsis: Haru suddenly awakens to the sound of rain in his room. Shaken by the sight of Ren in his dream, his breathing becomes erratic. Realizing the reason for his dream, the next morning Haru questions Ikuyoshi.
